description: Restaurant records from the Michelin Guide — star ratings, address, cuisine, coordinates, contact, and more.

restaurants.description: Dataset containing all scraped Michelin Guide restaurant records. Each record includes name, URL, stars/bibGourmand/michelinSelected distinction, city, country, cuisine, priceRange, countryCode, hasOnlineBooking, and (when includeDetails=true) address, phone, website, latitude, longitude, imageUrl, description, and openingHours.
